abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Brostamide increases side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop.
conclusion: To sum up, the comparison of the groups shows the following. Overall, Brostamide increases side effects compared with Standard care. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop.
section:
### Additional comparison

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. This comparison was run at the Riverside Pressure Registry.

Table 5. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Side effects | 65 | 250 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Side effects | 99 | 250 |

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Standard care | Systolic drop | 9.5 | 4.8 | 250 |
| Older adults, Normal kidney function, University hospital | Brostamide | Systolic drop | 9.9 | 5.0 | 250 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
